name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of 'good habits' (spec first, test everything, review before merge) that makes an AI coding assistant work like a disciplined senior engineer instead of a fast-and-sloppy one.
buyer: An engineering lead who has adopted AI coding agents on the team but is worried about quality and consistency across different developers' setups.
business_use_cases: A dev team standardizes every engineer's AI coding agent on the same spec-plan-build-test-review workflow so output quality doesn't vary by who's using it.
A solo developer uses '/code-simplify' and '/review' to catch over-engineered AI-generated code before it ships.
A consultancy builds a custom industry-specific skill (e.g. HIPAA-compliant code review) on top of the framework and licenses it to healthcare dev teams.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a specialized compliance or industry skill pack that plugs into this framework.
Offer 'AI coding agent setup and training' consulting for teams adopting it.

steal_this: Package a niche compliance skill (e.g. GDPR-aware code review) for this framework and sell it directly to teams in a regulated industry this weekend.
